The problem today

Defects don't fail handovers.
Defect management does.

Most builders track defects. Few can prove they were fixed — with photo evidence, a named person and a timestamp.

Spreadsheets with no accountability

Rows of defects with no photos, no assignments and no way to prove what was actually fixed.

Trades that go quiet

Defect assignment via text message with no follow-up system. Trades say it’s done. You have no proof.

Last-minute handover panic

Compiling evidence the night before PC. Chasing trades for photos they never took. Reports that aren’t defensible.

How CleanRun IQ solves it

One system. Every defect.
Full evidence chain.

Photo-first capture, always

A defect cannot be logged without a photo. Required at capture, rectification and closeout — enforced by the system.

Trade assignment with due dates

Every defect is issued to a named trade and subcontractor. Due dates are tracked. Overdue items are visible to everyone.

Evidence review and approval

The site manager reviews rectification evidence, approves or rejects, and controls closeout. No self-certification allowed.

Full audit trail, locked per item

Every action — creation, assignment, rectification, approval, closeout — is logged with name, date and time.

CleanRun IQ — Three Item Types
🔴
Defect
Work completed but below the required standard. Requires rectification and photo evidence before closeout.
🟡
Incomplete Work
Work not yet started or fully completed. Must be finished and evidenced before the item can close.
🔵
Client Defect
Defect items raised by the client post-handover. Managed through the same evidence-first workflow during DLP.
The CleanRun IQ process

Five steps to a clean handover.

Consistent. Repeatable. Defensible. The same process on every project.

01
Capture

Photo + type + location + trade. All required. No shortcuts.

02
Assign

Issued to trade + sub + due date. Clear accountability.

03
Rectify

The trade fixes it and uploads photo evidence from site.

04
Review

Site manager approves or rejects evidence. Full control.

05
Close + Report

Evidence chain locked. Handover report generated instantly.

Common questions about defect management.

CleanRun IQ tracks three item types: Defects (work completed below standard), Incomplete Works (work not yet started or finished) and Client Defects (items raised by the client post-handover). Each follows the same photo evidence workflow.

Every item requires a capture photo when logged. Rectification requires the subcontractor to upload at least one photo before the item moves to Review. Closeout requires site manager approval. The chain is enforced by the system and cannot be bypassed.

Yes. Subcontractors access their assigned items through a browser link — no download, no account setup. They see only the items assigned to them and upload rectification photos from any phone or tablet.

From the project defect register, select the items to include and click Generate Report. CleanRun IQ produces a structured PDF with all defect details, evidence photos and closeout status in seconds.

Yes. CleanRun IQ scales from small residential builds to large commercial and apartment projects. The workflow is consistent regardless of project size, making it easy to manage your whole portfolio the same way.
